verdict.rationale: Cursor's first-party Bugbot runs automatic reviews on every PR update across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps. It flags bugs, security issues and code-quality problems, reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicates, and posts Fix in Cursor/Web links. Security Agents also review PRs through Automations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality, and detailed documentation of how codebase context informs the feedback beyond PR comments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
